derivation.rule: The nearest preceding <h2 class="month-heading"> establishes the month and year for every event row that follows it until the next such heading; the row's own <span class="event-day"> supplies the day. Concatenate as <Year>-<MM>-<DD>. Exactly one heading governs this row in the retained fixture, so the combination is unambiguous.

derivation.rule: Every event row structurally nested (in the retained DOM) inside a <section class="venue-section" data-venue-name="..."> inherits that section's data-venue-name as its venue. Containment is checked mechanically: the row's own data-event-id must literally appear within the matched section's body — this is a structural parse check, not a judgement based on visual proximity or page layout.
